description: Users report errors or failures when creating accounts, signing in, or accessing the service after updates or while traveling.
Users object to subscription requirements and restrictions on features such as skipping, replaying, selecting, downloading, and stream recognition.
Users report missing music, search failures, removed content, and dissatisfaction with recommendation features.
Users report unavailable downloads or offline mode, deleted and repeatedly restored downloads, and problems with SD card storage.
Users express broad dissatisfaction, including disappointment after updates and reports that the app no longer works on their devices.
Users report songs stopping or failing to play, slow loading, unwanted audio behavior, and reduced video podcast playback support.
Users report difficulty contacting customer support and receiving timely responses.
Users report intrusive or repeated advertisements and the removal of convenient playback and navigation controls.
